usage.outputShape: body.enhanced_image_url (the upscaled/enhanced PNG URL); body.changes_applied[] (list of enhancements), body.quality_score (number), body.processedAt
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/image_enhancer with a JSON body containing the field image_url pointing to a public image URL. Pay the $0.010 USDC x402 charge on Base. The response is synchronous JSON; read the enhanced result from body.enhanced_image_url and inspect body.changes_applied[] and body.quality_score for what was done. No auth, no polling, no templates.
